user.title: Configure Nives
user.description: Enter the URL of your Nives API server.

data_description.api_token: Required for cloud-hosted Nives. Leave empty for self-hosted setups without authentication.
data_description.user_id: The name of the memory Nives keeps for your household. Leave it as 'default'. You can change it later, and choose whether everyone shares one memory, under Configure.

hassio_confirm.title: Nives Detected
hassio_confirm.description: The Nives add-on has been detected. Would you like to set it up?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Nives API. Make sure it's running and accessible.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API token. Check your token on the Nives dashboard.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Nives add-on. Make sure it's running.

init.title: Memory
init.description: Choose whether everyone in your home shares one memory with Nives.

data_description.shared_memory: On (recommended): everyone shares one memory, so something you tell a voice satellite is also known in the app and on the dashboard, and the other way round. Off: each Home Assistant user gets a memory of their own, and voice satellites and automations use the memory named below.
data_description.user_id: The memory Nives uses for the whole household, or, with shared memory off, for voice satellites and automations. Leave it as 'default' unless you have a reason to change it.

confirm.title: Restart required
confirm.description: Home Assistant needs a restart to finish updating Nives ({running_version} → {installed_version}). Click Submit to restart Home Assistant now — or close this and restart later, at a moment that suits you. Nives keeps working in the meantime.
